_comment: Fixed participant-facing lines. look is used in this exact order for every participant.
greeting: Hi, I'm Nao. I'm going to describe a Lego build to you one step at a time. Hold the top of my head while you talk to me, and let go when you're done. When you want me to check your build, press my foot.
